steps: Assess commercial courts for maritime monitoring & evaluation using World Bank enforcement indicators
Design specialized commercial court with expedited procedures and expertise
Implement with judicial training, e-filing, and case management system
Deploy alternative enforcement mechanisms with mediation before trial
Measure through enforcement time, cost, and business satisfaction
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — contract enforcement time using doing business indicators. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — contract enforcement time measured annually. Target: enforcement within 365 days. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against World Bank B-READY benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — contract enforcement time trending toward within 270 days. Escalate if <within 500 days ceiling. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using World Bank enforcement framework. Report to Commercial Court Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a criminal justice system reform specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
